# NOTE: `VERSION` inside juce_add_plugin is honoured (it is the JUCE keyword);
# do NOT add a separate PLUGIN_VERSION — that keyword does not exist and ships
# 1.0.0 silently (memory critical_plugin_version_keyword_ignored_by_juce).
# Every `O-Prism` token below (target_sources, target_include_directories,
# target_link_libraries, juce_generate_juce_header, ouaricon_add_module,
# target_compile_definitions, ouaricon_add_param_dump) becomes `O-Strata`.

# ── Hunk 4: WebView UI resources ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# ONE binary-data target only. Two juce_add_binary_data targets collide on the
# BinaryData namespace (memory critical_dual_binary_data_namespace_collision) —
# built-in meshes are procedural C++ (Decision 4) precisely so no second target
# is needed. If a literal asset is ever added, it joins THIS target.
# Symbol names: juce_add_binary_data STRIPS hyphens and non-alphanumerics
# (memory critical_binary_data_strips_hyphens):
#   index.html                                    → BinaryData::index_html
#   js/i18n.js                                    → BinaryData::i18n_js
#   js/juce/index.js                              → BinaryData::index_js
#   js/juce/check_native_interop.js               → BinaryData::check_native_interop_js
#   js/geometry-view.js                           → BinaryData::geometryview_js   (hyphen stripped!)
#   img/shell_conchologiaiconi12reev_0090.png     → BinaryData::shell_conchologiaiconi12reev_0090_png

# ── Hunk 5: compile definitions (unchanged values; shown for the guard note) ─
 target_compile_definitions(O-Strata
     PUBLIC
         JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
         JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=1
         JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2_WITH_STATIC_LINKING=1     # memory critical_webview2_static_linking
         JUCE_USE_CURL=0
 )
# `createEditor()` in PluginProcessor.cpp is wrapped in `#if JUCE_WEB_BROWSER`
# (returns nullptr / a GenericAudioProcessorEditor otherwise) so the offline
# render harness (Stage 2.5) builds with -DJUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0 without pulling
# PluginEditor.cpp's WebView code (ROADMAP "Known Challenges": harness must
# keep building after Stage 3; memory pattern_render_harness_breaks_on_webview_editor).
# The harness target sets:  target_compile_definitions(<harness> PRIVATE JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0)
# and does NOT link O-Strata_UIResources.
